messages.content:
Three independent readers read the same non-disclosure agreement (NDA) and decided whether it supports one statement (the hypothesis). They may agree or disagree, and a program has checked each of their quotes against the document. Your job is to make the final decision yourself, from the document.

<document>
<document 575 omitted, sha256 7db7c8fa07676ede>
</document>

<hypothesis>
Some obligations of Agreement may survive termination of Agreement.
</hypothesis>

<readings>
<reading id="A">
label: Entailment
confidence: 95
reason: Section 11 expressly states that the Agreement's restrictions and obligations survive termination for five years, so some obligations survive termination.
<quote check="exact">The restrictions and obligations of this Agreement shall continue and shall survive the termination of the Purpose of the disclosure for a period of five (5) years.</quote>
</reading>
<reading id="B">
label: Entailment
confidence: 93
reason: Section 11 expressly provides that restrictions and obligations continue for five years after the purpose of disclosure terminates, so some obligations survive.
<quote check="exact">The restrictions and obligations of this Agreement shall continue and shall survive the termination of the Purpose of the disclosure for a period of five (5) years.</quote>
</reading>
<reading id="C">
label: Entailment
confidence: 88
reason: The survival clause keeps obligations alive for five years after the purpose ends, and the return obligation explicitly applies after the Agreement terminates, so some obligations outlast termination.
<quote check="exact">The restrictions and obligations of this Agreement shall continue and shall survive the termination of the Purpose of the disclosure for a period of five (5) years.</quote>
<quote check="exact">within thirty (30) days following the termination of this Agreement</quote>
</reading>
</readings>

The readings are evidence about where to look, not votes: a majority can be wrong, and a quote marked "missing" was not found in the document. Read the relevant parts of the document yourself.

Choose exactly one label:
- Entailment: the document states or clearly implies that the hypothesis is true.
- Contradiction: the document states or clearly implies that the hypothesis is false.
- NotMentioned: the document does not address the hypothesis, or says too little to decide.

Evidence is required. For Entailment or Contradiction, give 1 to 3 quotes copied character for character from the document (no paraphrase, no ellipses), each as short as it can be while still carrying the point. They will be checked against the document. For NotMentioned, give an empty list.

Give a confidence from 0 to 100: your probability, in percent, that your label is correct. Give a one-sentence reason.

Answer only with the JSON object the response format asks for: label, confidence, quotes, reason.

content.text: {"label":"Entailment","confidence":90,"quotes":["The restrictions and obligations of this Agreement shall continue and shall survive the termination of the Purpose of the disclosure for a period of five (5) years.","within thirty (30) days following the termination of this Agreement"],"reason":"Section 11 keeps the restrictions and obligations in force for five years after the purpose of disclosure ends, and Section 3(e) expressly requires return of information after the Agreement terminates, so some obligations outlast termination."}
